title: Fixture service - reason codes
description: A small valid store for the tests. Not a real service.

codes.description: A code entry applies to every enrolment type, so it is the ANY material for this reason code. Raised when the fixture service cannot reconcile the packet against its own records.
A code entry that sits alongside typed rules, so an E packet and a U packet each get this plus their own rule.

rules.description: Fixture rejection rule in FIXTURE_BATCH_1. This rule fires when the enrolment type is 'ENROLMENT' (New Enrolment); AND there is more than 0 unique candidate(s). The APPLICANT is REJECTED.
rules.condition_description: the enrolment type is 'ENROLMENT' (New Enrolment); AND there is more than 0 unique candidate(s)

rules.description: Fixture rejection rule in FIXTURE_BATCH_1. This rule fires when the enrolment type is 'UPDATE' (Update); AND the applicant matched a different parent. The APPLICANT is REJECTED.
rules.condition_description: the enrolment type is 'UPDATE' (Update); AND the applicant matched a different parent

rules.description: Fixture rejection rule in FIXTURE_BATCH_2. This rule fires when the applicant face photo failed the capture quality check. The APPLICANT is REJECTED.
rules.condition_description: the applicant face photo failed the capture quality check
